data.name: Title
data.value: Apply for a passport – review and send

data.name: Fee_Hint
data.value: according to § 27 PassV, payable at the appointment

data.name: Level_Ok
data.value: You are signed in with “{0}” – that is sufficient. The application is received directly when you send it.

data.name: Level_StepUp
data.value: For a passport the citizens' office requires the trust level “{0}”; you are signed in with “{1}”. When you send it, the portal briefly takes you to BundID – sign in there, for example with ELSTER or your online ID card. Afterwards you come back to this page and send the application.

data.name: Level_Technical_Text
data.value: The portal starts a new OpenID Connect request with acr_values=STORK-QAA-Level-3. The auth server turns it into a SAML AuthnRequest with RequestedAuthnContext “substantial” (comparison minimum); BundID then only offers suitable identification methods. The signed response contains the level reached, and the API checks it again when the application is submitted.

data.name: Next1
data.value: You receive a confirmation of receipt in your BundID mailbox.

data.name: Next2
data.value: For signature and fingerprints you need an appointment at the citizens' office –

data.name: Next3
data.value: You can see the processing status at any time under “My applications”.

data.name: StepUp_Ok
data.value: You are now signed in with the trust level “{0}”. Check your details and send the application.
